case_level_notes: Mixed-file plus incomplete identity theft signals with conflicting dates and missing primary documents; route to human review and hold compliance determinations as undetermined.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: No facts about a consumer statement appear in the packet.

material_facts.fact: Reinvestigation outcome is not yet decided

determinations.rationale: Reinvestigation is not complete and no consumer statement has been filed or addressed in the packet.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Packet does not show whether CRA has completed reasonable review.

material_facts.fact: Inconsistent dates across CRA file and furnisher response
Identity theft affidavit not yet provided

determinations.rationale: CRA has not received sufficient material to evaluate; inconsistent dates and missing identity theft report prevent a finding on reasonableness.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Existence of a furnisher response does not establish timely or complete notice.

material_facts.fact: Furnisher response is referenced
No timing data on CRA-to-furnisher notice

determinations.rationale: Packet does not record whether or when the CRA notified the furnishers within 5 business days.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Trigger is based on explicit dispute in the narrative.

material_facts.fact: Consumer disputes three collection accounts as 'not mine'

determinations.rationale: Consumer disputed accuracy of three collection accounts ('not mine'), identifying items and basis; this triggers the CRA reinvestigation duty.

material_facts.fact: No reinvestigation completion date in packet

determinations.rationale: No dates of receipt or completion are provided to evaluate the 30/45-day window.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Trigger validity assessed from explicit dispute content.

material_facts.fact: Three collection accounts disputed as not the consumer's

determinations.rationale: Dispute identifies consumer, accounts (three collections), disputed field (ownership/accuracy), and basis ('not mine').

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Absence from open narrative is not proof of absence.

material_facts.fact: Dispute is to CRA, no direct-furnisher facts present

determinations.rationale: No indication of a direct dispute to a furnisher in the packet.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Compliance cannot be asserted given unresolved sub-determinations.

material_facts.fact: Inconsistent dates and missing identity theft report

determinations.rationale: Multiple sub-duties are undetermined; cannot conclude overall compliance.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: No express termination action is recorded.

material_facts.fact: CRA lacks sufficient material to decide

determinations.rationale: Packet does not indicate the CRA has invoked a frivolous/irrelevant termination, though materials are insufficient; status unclear.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Existence of response does not confirm full duty satisfaction.

material_facts.fact: Furnisher response referenced with inconsistent dates

determinations.rationale: Furnisher response exists but its sufficiency, completeness, and treatment of mixed-file/identity theft signals is not described.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Routing criteria explicitly include mixed-file and identity theft ambiguity with missing primary documents.

material_facts.fact: Identity theft affidavit being prepared but not provided
Two addresses for a similar-named person
Inconsistent dates across CRA file and furnisher response
Police incident number provided but not actual report

determinations.rationale: Plausible but incomplete identity theft evidence, possible mixed-file (similar name, two addresses), conflicting dates, and missing primary source (identity theft report) trigger human review routing.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Cannot assess treatment without a verification outcome.

material_facts.fact: Items remain undetermined as mixed-file, identity theft, or verified

determinations.rationale: No determination has yet been made whether items are inaccurate/unverifiable; treatment cannot be evaluated.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Open-world absence is not proof reinsertion has or has not occurred.

material_facts.fact: No reinsertion facts in narrative

determinations.rationale: No reinsertion event described in the packet.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Absence in open narrative does not establish non-applicability.

material_facts.fact: No reseller referenced

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Results notice cannot be evaluated before completion.

material_facts.fact: CRA has not yet decided the items

determinations.rationale: Reinvestigation not complete; no results notice facts are present.
